reason: The cited lines do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not show file contents or other non-public data being returned into the agent context; they resolve filenames and set them on a browser file chooser, but no secret content is returned. They do show a sink: supplied file paths are passed to `fileChooser.setFiles(...)`, making those files available to the browser page/file upload destination. `response2.setIncludeSnapshot()` indicates the tool response includes a browser snapshot, which is page-derived content and can be attacker-controlled/untrusted.
